limits: Release-only availability is based on current manifests and extant assets, not fresh loading of every archived weight.
Portable exports and original training files are counted as the same run using source_sha256.
No existing cell guarantees matching seeds, training RNG, splits, teacher identity or recipe across all seven arms.
Manuscript/ledger/screenshot scores are not evidence of surviving checkpoint bytes.
Weights elsewhere on an old host or in an unexamined external backup may still exist.
No training, queue modification, model upload, or git push was performed by this audit.
